ngaap.notes: EBITDA/Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation from the Q1-18 10-Q MD&A ($ millions, 1dp; Q1-19 release comparative: EBITDA 167,705k, Adj 167,843k). Adjusted EPS 0.44 is NOT in the Q1-18 10-Q; taken from the Q1-19 release prior-year column (Q2-18 release 6M 1.66 less Q2 1.23 = 0.43, rounding). Q1-19 release labels the business-development line 'Business development' (516k) and BI recovery (1,694k). Cash GP per ton 5.28 per 10-Q. Reconciliation (exact): Net earnings + income tax expense (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + (earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax [+0.4] = EBIT; + DDA&A = EBITDA. So ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly that discontinued-ops add-back (0.4; extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added); EBITDA is a continuing-operations measure. adj_items.disc_ops = null (disc ops is excluded above EBITDA, not in the EBITDA->Adjusted bridge). Mapping: Gain on sale of businesses -> gain_sale; Business interruption claims recovery (2010 Gulf Coast oil spill claims settlement) -> legal_env; Charges associated with divested operations -> divested_ops; Business development (non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up) -> acquisition; Restructuring charges -> restructuring; Property donation / One-time employee bonuses -> other. impairment/pension = 0 (no such lines in bridge). Adjusted EPS bridge starts from diluted EPS from continuing operations; eps_items_after_tax_ps = 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' + debt refinancing costs / debt-purchase interest charges (after tax); eps_discrete_tax_ps = tax reform savings + Alabama NOL valuation allowance + foreign tax credit lines.
